topic: Registering a Kid for a Soccer League and Volunteering

script.title: SOCCER SIGNUP DAY
script.story_hook: One parent, one clipboard, and a brand new season.
script.intro_zh: 一位家長、一塊記名板，和一個全新球季。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the soccer signup tent. Listen for handy school-age phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到足球報名帳篷。留意實用的學齡說法。
script.outro: And that's a season started smoothly. Try the tricky lines again.
script.outro_zh: 一個球季就這樣順利開始。再把難句唸一遍。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: She's going to have so much fun
script.char_a_description: a warm mother in her late thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair in a loose side braid, a light blue windbreaker, faded jeans, running sneakers, and an average build
script.char_b_description: a friendly retired coach in his early sixties with thinning silver hair, a short grey beard, a navy team polo, khaki shorts, a whistle on a lanyard, and a stocky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the table for soccer signup?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈteɪbəl fɔɹ ˈsɑkɚ ˈsaɪnˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這裡是足球報名桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, welcome. How old is your child?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwɛlkəm haʊ ˈoʊld ɪz jɔɹ ˈtʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，歡迎。你家小孩幾歲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She just turned five last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdʒʌst ˈtɜrnd ˈfaɪv ˈlæst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 她上個月剛滿五歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five goes in the Under Six bracket.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɡoʊz ɪn ði ˈʌndɚ sɪks ˈbrækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 五歲分在六歲以下組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's the group we wanted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæts ðə ɡrup wɪ ˈwɑntɪd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們就想進這組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I just need a birth date here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ dʒʌst ˈnid ə ˈbɝθ ˈdeɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，這裡只要填出生日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: August twelfth, twenty twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɡəst twɛlfθ ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 八月十二日，二〇二〇年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you have a copy with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt du ju hæv ə ˈkɑpi wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。你有帶影印本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I only have the original at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ ˈoʊli hæv ði əˈrɪdʒənəl æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我手邊只有放在家裡的正本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, a photo counts these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈkaʊnts ðiːz ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，現在照片也算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, let me find it on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd lɛt mi ˈfaɪnd ɪt ɑn maɪ ˈfoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，我在手機上找一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. Next, what's her uniform size?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ nɛkst wɑts hɚ ˈjunəˌfɔɹm saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不用急。接著，制服尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wears a small, maybe a medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɛɹz ə smɔl ˈmeɪbi ə ˈmidiəm/
dialogue.zh: 她穿小號，也許中號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd grab the medium, they grow so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ɡɹæb ðə ˈmidiəm ðeɪ ɡɹoʊ soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 我會拿中號，小孩長得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Does the fee cover shirt and shorts?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu dʌz ðə fi kəˈvɚ ˈʃɝt ənd ʃɔɹts/
dialogue.zh: 也是。費用包含球衣和短褲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus socks, but not the cleats.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ˈsɑks bʌt ˈnɑt ðə ˈklits/
dialogue.zh: 含，還加襪子，但不含球鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any cleats I should avoid buying?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni klits aɪ ʃud əˈvɔɪd ˈbaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有什麼球鞋不該買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip the metal ones, plastic is safer here.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðə ˈmɛɾəl wʌnz ˈplæstɪk ɪz ˈseɪfɚ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 金屬的跳過，這裡塑膠的較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. Now, when do practices start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd naʊ wɛn du ˈpɹæktəsɪz stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。訓練幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday and Thursday, around four thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌndeɪ ænd ˈθɝzdeɪ əˈɹaʊnd fɔɹ ˈθɝti/
dialogue.zh: 週一和週四，大約四點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, Thursdays are tough, she has piano.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈθɝzdeɪz ɑɹ ˈtʌf ʃi hæz pæˈnoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，週四有點難，她要上鋼琴課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, nobody must make both nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ˈnoʊbədi mʌst ˈmeɪk ˈboʊθ naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，沒規定兩晚都要到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɹɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說鬆了一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, registration is sixty five dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˌɛdʒəˈstɹeɪʃən ɪz ˈsɪksti faɪv ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 報名費是六十五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a discount for a second kid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈdɪskaʊnt fɚ ə ˈsɛkənd kɪd/
dialogue.zh: 第二個小孩有折扣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is, ten dollars off each after that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ɪz tɛn ˈdɑlərz ɔf itʃ ˈæftɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 有，之後每個再減十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, my little boy joins in the spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs maɪ ˈlɪɾəl bɔɪ dʒɔɪnz ɪn ðə spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真好，我家的小男孩春天也報名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'd love that. Can I grab your email?
dialogue.phonetic: /wid lʌv ðæt kən aɪ ɡɹæb jɔɹ ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。可以留電子郵件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it's the address on this flyer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪts ði ˈædrəs ɑn ðɪs ˈflaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，就是這張傳單上的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing, we need a helper coach.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ wi nid ə ˈhɛlpɚ koʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，我們需要一位助理教練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, like a volunteer?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ laɪk ə ˌvɑləˈnɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，志願者那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, it cuts the fee in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt kʌts ðə fi ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 就是，報名費還能減一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I could do that on Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ kʊd du ðæt ɑn ˈmʌnˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，週一我應該有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd only need the sheet signed by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jud ˈoʊli nid ðə ʃit saɪnd baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只要在週五前簽好那張表就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'm not great with kids, to be honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪm nɑt ɡɹeɪt wɪð kɪdz tə bi ˈɑnəst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，說實話我不太會帶小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody starts great, the parents really help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi stɑɹts ɡɹeɪt ðə ˈpɛɹənts ˈɹiəli hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 沒人天生會帶，家長幫忙就很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll try it for one season.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl tɹaɪ ɪt fɚ wʌn ˈsizən/
dialogue.zh: 好，我一個球季試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Love that. Do you want to pay now?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌv ðæt du ju ˈwɑnt tə ˈpeɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。現在就付費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I split it with another parent?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ splɪt ɪt wɪð əˈnʌðɚ ˈpɛɹənt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以和另一位家長分攤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a phone app works fine for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ə foʊn æp ˈwɜks faɪn fɚ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 可以，用手機支付對我們沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, um, is there a sponsor option?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈspɑnsɚ ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，有贊助商選項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a business covers a whole team.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈbɪznəs kəˈvɚz ə ˈhoʊl ˈtim/
dialogue.zh: 有，商家可以贊助整隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My uncle has a bakery around here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʌŋkəl hæz ə ˈbeɪkəɹi əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我的叔叔在附近開一家麵包店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better, tell him to email me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ tɛl ɪm tə ˈimeɪl mi/
dialogue.zh: 那更好，請他寄信給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll love putting his name on a banner.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil lʌv ˈpʊɾɪŋ hɪz neɪm ɑn ə ˈbænɚ/
dialogue.zh: 他會喜歡把名字掛在橫幅上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always need banners. Anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlweɪz nid ˈbænɚz ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 我們常缺橫幅。還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do games fall on weekends or weekdays?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɡeɪmz fɔl ɑn ˈwikˌɛndz ɔɹ ˈwikˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 比賽排在週末還是平日？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturdays mostly, we stop before noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪz ˈmoʊstli wi stɑp bɪˈfɔɹ nun/
dialogue.zh: 多半在週六，中午前結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, our Sundays are for grandma's house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɑɹ ˈsʌnˌdeɪz ɔɹ ˈɡɹæməz haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 很好，我們週日去奶奶家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's her roster form and a schedule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz hɚ ˈɹɑstɚ fɔɹm ænd ə ˈskɛdʒul/
dialogue.zh: 這是她的名單表格和時間表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I print this or keep the file?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈpɹɪnt ðɪs ɔɹ ˈkip ði ˈfaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這個該列印還是存成檔案？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the file, we text reminders too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə faɪl wi tɛkst ɹɪˈmaɪndɚz tu/
dialogue.zh: 存檔就好，我們也會發簡訊提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've made this really easy, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv meɪd ðɪs ˈɹiəli ˈizi θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你讓這一切很輕鬆，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what I'm here for, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt aɪm hɪɹ fɔɹ ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我就是為這個來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll see you at the Monday practice.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl si ju æt ðə ˈmʌndeɪ ˈpɹæktɪs/
dialogue.zh: 週一訓練時見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring water and her shin guards, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ˈwɔɾɚ ænd ɚ ʃɪn ɡɑɹdz oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記得帶水和護腿板，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shin guards, water, got it noted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɪn ɡɑɹdz ˈwɔɾɚ ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈnoʊɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 護腿板、水，我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's going to have so much fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə hæv soʊ mʌtʃ ˈfʌn/
dialogue.zh: 她會玩得很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're excited already, see you Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ɪkˈsaɪɾɪd ɔlˈɛdi si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們已經很期待了，週六見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, give her my high five in advance.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɡɪv ɚ maɪ haɪ faɪv ɪn ædˈvæns/
dialogue.zh: 再見，記得代我跟她擊個掌。

script.youtube_title: 【社區足球報名⚽】「她會玩得很開心」一次搞懂分齡、球衣尺寸與贊助費🥅🎧｜聽完就能自己報名｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Registering for a Soccer League
script.youtube_title_en: "She's Going to Have So Much Fun" — Signing a Kid Up for Soccer
script.youtube_description:
「她會玩得很開心」——在社區球場邊的報名桌前，怎麼幫小孩完成足球聯賽報名？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在週末剛架好的報名帳篷。

你會聽到：說明分齡組別、填出生日期、只有正本沒帶影印本時怎麼處理；選球衣大小、確認費用含不含球鞋；訓練夜衝突時怎麼調度；還有用當志工換減費、請親戚的店家贊助整隊。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與日常短句，反覆出現的是美國家長在球場邊真實的語感：um、oh、so、got it。聽完你就會用：How old is、Does the fee cover、Can I split it、Anything else、See you Saturday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"She's going to have so much fun" — how do you sign your kid up for a soccer league at a busy community tent? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the registration table.

You will hear: choosing the age bracket, giving a birth date, handling a missing copy; picking a uniform size and asking what the fee covers; sorting a practice-night clash; and volunteering to cut the fee or asking a local shop to sponsor a whole team.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk parents actually use: um, so, oh, got it. By the end you'll own phrases like How old is, Does the fee cover, and Can I split it.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧足球報名英文｜分齡組別・球衣尺寸・贊助費｜當志工換減費怎麼辦｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
週末的社區球場邊，報名帳篷前排了許多家長，你要怎麼幫剛滿五歲的小孩完成足球聯賽報名？球衣該拿哪個尺寸、費用到底含什麼、訓練夜剛好撞堂怎麼調度？

這一集帶大家走進一場足球報名，從說明分齡、填出生日期、選球衣大小，一路聽到付款、當志工減費與請親戚店家贊助，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
⚽ 分齡句：Five goes in the Under Six bracket.
👕 選尺寸：She wears a small, maybe a medium.
💳 問費用：Does the fee cover shirt and shorts?
🤝 換減費：Exactly, it cuts the fee in half.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、got it 這些自然語感一路唸到熟。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這位家長在報名桌前站一回，下次自己替孩子報名，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你家小孩球季開門紅。
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at an age group chart on the table
